description:
Update a blog article. Only the fields you pass are changed — each one becomes a command in the
same dashboard pipeline create_article uses. NOTE: renaming regenerates the slug, so pass slug in
the SAME call if you want a custom one (it is applied after the rename).

category_ids.description: Blog category IDs to file the post under (added, existing ones are kept)

content.description: New HTML content (replaces the old content)

images.description: Hosted image URLs; the first is the cover image

name.description: New title (regenerates the slug unless slug is also passed)

remove_category_ids.description: Blog category IDs to unfile the post from

seo.description: SEO settings to change; other existing SEO tags are kept. Pass "" to clear a field.

custom_tags.description: Extra tags ("Thẻ bổ sung"), e.g. { "type": "meta", "props": { "name": "author", "content": "Togi" } }. Replaces a tag with the same name/property/rel.

og_image.description: Social share image URL (og:image), must be hosted

robots.description: Robots meta, comma+space separated, e.g. "noindex, nofollow" or "max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large"

structured_data.description: Structured data markup (JSON-LD). REPLACES all existing markups; [] removes them.

json.description: JSON-LD object as a string, without <script>

tags.description: Article TAG IDs (uuids from the blog tag list) — not free text

name: update_article
